'''Lanius Carr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. When the [[Corellia Chemical Corporation factory]] in [[Labor Valley]] was damaged in the [[Battle of Corellia|fighting]] and became dangerously close to overloading, Lanius tasked a Republic hero to stop this disaster before thousands of innocent [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] could be lost in the chemical explosion.
